title: Minimal power
text:
Minimal power. I am shocked at how little power this immersion blender has, especially for the premium price tag. I bought this specifically to make home made evoo mayo, weekly. It does not have enough to create an emulsion, even in the beginning of the process with minimal olive oil. I tried all 3 blades. So I started again - I could not get an emulsion with just egg yolks & a teaspoon of mustard. 😡
I was expecting this to perform better than my Braun, which cost 1/2 the price with more attachments. There is no comparison.

My Braun creates an emulsion, every time. The only drawback is, the attachment head fills with mayo & is not easy to clean.

imo, There is no way this Bamix would be able to blend a pot of hot, simmering vegetable sauce, of any kind.
Also, I want to point out, the shaft is not removable, so to clean this, you have to wash it in the sink with the cord hanging over the edge.
Straight into the donation box. Worst appliance I have ever purchased. Ridiculously over priced
